settings.note: Use Case 2T v1.4: G0 on plan test and visit cards, the test reminder; a Booked tap moves a test card to Booked with no date; Record booking or the appointment list add the date; the simulated lab report is linked and verified by MRN and test code; the report check asks the patient once the test date has passed (hospital data first); an outside report is scored (seven hard checks, a score out of 100) and routed: auto-matched to the doctor with a coordinator copy, a coordinator Verify task, or the possible wrong report message. Use Case 2a and 2b behaviour otherwise.
